description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Twin Element Mode II (Water, Poison)], [Awoken Captain's Fury], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Sisterly Spirit Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Captain's Fury
description.text: Water and Poison abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water and Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Water, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] after using a Water/Poison ability

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Poison with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Sisterly Spirit Mode
description.text: Casts Scourge Splash (Water/Poison) after using two Water or Poison abilities if the triggering ability deals Water/Poison damage, removed after triggering

description.name: Scourge Splash (Water)
description.text: Grants [Instant Cast 1], [Soul Break Gauge +250], removes Sisterly Spirit Mode from the user

description.name: Scourge Splash (Poison)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Poison 10% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Poison] to the user, removes Sisterly Spirit Mode from the user

description.name: Buff Poison 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Poison damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Poison
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Poison damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Poison resistance +20%
